svg.aria-label: Plate II, fault lines: five claims of mine broken by my own evidence. TCMF version one scored recall at 5 of 0.02 where the causal signal alone reaches 1.00. COLD READ's confidently-wrong finding did not replicate on a second model. AUGUR's forecasting programme was killed by its own phase zero. adk-python 6190 was closed after an LGTM when a maintainer's commit landed first. AFTERSHOCK's song-placement effect was discarded over data terms and did not replicate.

svg.text: Five places I said something, went looking for the evidence, and the rock gave way. The breaks stay on the record.
claimed: the fix for a CLI
A result that was never allowed to fail is not evidence of anything.
